term: Giant cell and spindle cell carcinoma
rationale: Giant cell and spindle cell (sarcomatoid/pleomorphic) carcinoma is a generic dedifferentiated morphology reported across many organs (lung, pancreas, biliary, urinary tract, thyroid, breast); it is not anatomically restricted to a proper subset of its broad ceiling.
source_name: WHO 5th ed bladder classification review (Guo et al 2022, Bladder Cancer journal)
